10.1 训练 LLM: 显存与算力需求
Training LLMs: Memory and compute requirements

学习目标与引入
Learning goals · From Transformer architecture to training cost

Slide 0–1

Deep Learning for NLP — Training LLMs — Memory and compute requirements

Learning goals

  • Learn about different contributions to compute requirements
  • Learn how model size components influence memory requirements

From Transformer architecture to training cost

You already know how a Transformer is built. Now we want to turn its architecture into concrete numbers:

  • How many parameters does it have?
    • How do dmodel​, number of layers, and other architectural choices determine model size?
  • How much compute does training require?
    • How do model size and number of training tokens determine the number of operations?
  • How much GPU memory does training require?
    • Parameters are only one part: we also need to store gradients, optimizer states, and activations.

Architecture ⟶ parameters ⟶ compute and memory

目标: 了解训练的计算量由哪些部分构成; 了解模型规模的各个组成部分怎样影响显存需求. 这一讲把已经熟悉的 Transformer 结构换算成具体数字: 有多少参数 (dmodel​、层数等结构选择如何决定模型大小)? 训练要多少计算 (模型大小和训练词元数如何决定运算次数)? 要多少 GPU 显存 (参数只是一部分, 还要存梯度、优化器状态和激活值)? 思路是一条链: 结构 → 参数量 → 计算量和显存.

这份课件是 9.7 节 (旧版 9compute) 的重写版, 推导更系统; 与 3.4 节 (Transformer 的参数量) 衔接.

一个 Transformer 块的参数
Where are the parameters in a Transformer block?

Slide 2–3

A decoder Transformer block mainly contains parameters in self-attention and the feed-forward network (MLP).

Self-attention:

  • Query, key, and value projections: WQ​,WK​,WV​dmodel​×(nheads​dhead​)
  • Output projection: WO​(nheads​dhead​)×dmodel​

Feed-forward network (MLP):

  • Two weight matrices, typically with hidden dimension 4dmodel​: dmodel​×4dmodel​ and 4dmodel​×dmodel​

In the standard Transformer, nheads​dhead​=dmodel​.

Parameter count of one Transformer block

Using nheads​dhead​=dmodel​, self-attention (WQ​,WK​,WV​,WO​) contributes

Pattn​=4dmodel2​

The MLP contributes

PMLP​=2⋅dmodel​⋅4dmodel​=8dmodel2​.

Hence, Pblock​=12dmodel2​​ and for nlayers​, Pblocks​=12nlayers​dmodel2​​

解码器块的参数几乎全部在自注意力和前馈网络 (MLP) 里. 自注意力有 Q、K、V 三个投影 (每个 dmodel​×nheads​dhead​) 和一个输出投影; 标准 Transformer 里 nheads​dhead​=dmodel​, 所以四个矩阵都是 dmodel2​, 合计 4dmodel2​. MLP 两个矩阵, 隐藏维 4dmodel​, 合计 8dmodel2​. 一个块 12dmodel2​, nlayers​ 层就是 12nlayers​dmodel2​.

这是忽略偏置和 LayerNorm 的近似, 和 3.4 节 (Slide 14) 的「每层约 12d2」是同一个结果 (那里是编码器层; 原版解码器层有两个注意力, 是 16d2, 而 GPT 这类只有解码器的模型去掉了交叉注意力, 所以又回到 12d2).

近似准不准: GPT-3 的例子
Does the approximation work?

Slide 4

GPT-3 Small (nlayers​=12, dmodel​=768): Brown et al., 2020: GPT-3

Pblocks​≈12⋅12⋅7682≈85M.

Actual model size: 125M parameters.

GPT-3 Medium (nlayers​=24, dmodel​=1024):

Pblocks​≈12⋅24⋅10242≈302M.

Actual model size: 350M parameters.

What is missing? Mainly the token embeddings. For vocabulary size ∣V∣, Pembed​=∣V∣dmodel​.

GPT-3 has ∣V∣≈50,000, hence approximately Pembed​≈39M (Small), 51M (Medium).

Other parameters (e.g., LayerNorms and biases) are comparatively small.

用 GPT-3 的两个小号检验公式. Small: 12⋅12⋅7682=84.9M, 实际 125M; Medium: 12⋅24⋅10242=302.0M, 实际 350M. 差的主要是词元嵌入 ∣V∣dmodel​: GPT-3 的词表 50 257 个词元, 嵌入层 Small 38.6M、Medium 51.5M. 加上以后 84.9 + 38.6 = 123.5M ≈ 125M, 302.0 + 51.5 = 353.5M ≈ 350M, 剩下的零头是 LayerNorm、偏置和位置嵌入 (我用 Python 逐项算过).

为什么小模型差得多: 嵌入层随 d 线性增长, 各层参数随 d2 增长. 模型越大, 嵌入层的占比越小: 对 Small 它占三成, 对 175B 的 GPT-3 (嵌入约 6 亿) 不到 0.4%, 那时 12nlayers​d2 就几乎是全部参数.

训练计算量: 前向和反向
Training compute: forward pass · backward pass

Slide 5–6

Training compute: forward pass

Let P be the number of parameters and D the number of training tokens. For one token, each parameter participates in roughly one multiply-add operation. A multiply-add costs approximately 2 FLOPs: a⋅b+c

Therefore, over D training tokens, Cforward​≈2PD​

Hence, forward-pass compute grows linearly with

  • the number of model parameters P,
  • the number of training tokens D.

Training compute: backward pass

In the forward pass, a layer computes Y=XW. During backpropagation, it must compute

  • gradients for the weights W,
  • gradients for the layer input X (to continue backpropagation).

Both require matrix multiplications of similar size to the forward pass. Thus, backward costs roughly twice as much as forward: Cbackward​≈4PD.

Together, C≈2PD+4PD=6PD​

每个词元经过模型时, 每个参数大约参与一次「乘加」(a⋅b+c), 算 2 个浮点运算 (FLOP), 所以前向 Cforward​≈2PD, 与参数量和词元数都成正比. 反向时一层 Y=XW 要算两样东西: 对权重的梯度 ∂L/∂W=X⊤∂L/∂Y (用来更新), 对输入的梯度 ∂L/∂X=∂L/∂YW⊤ (继续往前传); 两次都是和前向同样大小的矩阵乘法, 所以反向约是前向的两倍, 4PD. 合计 C≈6PD.

易错: 6PD 只算了和参数相乘的运算, 忽略了注意力分数 QK⊤ 本身 (它和序列长度的平方有关, 不对应任何参数). 对上下文不太长的大模型, 这部分占比小; 上下文很长时就不能忽略. 用了激活重计算 (Slide 13) 时, 前向要多做一遍, 实际是约 8PD.

从 FLOP 到训练时间
From FLOPs to training time

Slide 7

Training requires C≈6PD floating-point operations. If the hardware achieves throughput τ FLOP/s, then

T≈τC​=τ6PD​

Source: Quentin et al., 2023

Example: 7B parameters trained on 1T tokens: C≈6⋅7⋅109⋅1012=4.2⋅1022 FLOPs.

Training can be distributed across multiple GPUs. Ideally, τ≈nGPU​⋅τGPU​.

In practice, communication and synchronization prevent ideal linear scaling.

硬件吞吐量为每秒 τ 次浮点运算时, 训练时间 T≈6PD/τ. 例: 70 亿参数、1 万亿词元: 6⋅7⋅109⋅1012=4.2⋅1022 FLOP. 多块 GPU 理想情况下吞吐量线性相加; 实际上通信和同步使得达不到线性.

算一下要多久: 一块 A100 的 BF16 峰值约 312 TFLOP/s, 实际训练通常只能用到四到五成 (模型 FLOP 利用率 MFU 约 40%), 按 125 TFLOP/s 算: 4.2⋅1022/1.25⋅1014≈3.4⋅108 秒 ≈ 3900 GPU 天, 用 1000 块 GPU 约 4 天.

引用笔误: 「Quentin et al., 2023」用的是作者的名字. 这篇是 EleutherAI 的博客「Transformer Math 101」, 第一作者 Quentin Anthony, 应写 Anthony et al., 2023 (9.7 节的旧版课件同样写错).

固定算力预算下的选择
A fixed compute budget leaves a choice

Slide 8

Training compute is approximately C≈6PD, where

  • P = number of model parameters,
  • D = number of training tokens.

For a fixed compute budget C, PD≈ constant.

So we can choose between, for example,

  • a larger model trained on fewer tokens,
  • a smaller model trained on more tokens.

Which choice gives the best model?

This question (and similar tradeoffs) is addressed by scaling laws.

算力预算固定时, 参数量和词元数的乘积固定: 可以训练一个大模型、少看些数据, 也可以训练一个小模型、多看些数据. 哪个更好? 这正是规模定律要回答的问题 (10.2 节).

显存里存了什么
What occupies GPU memory?

Slide 9

How big will the model be in bytes? Will it fit on my GPU?

Memory is approximately: number of stored values × bytes per value.

For inference, we mainly store

  • model parameters,
  • activations.

Training additionally requires

  • gradients,
  • optimizer states.

Thus, Mtrain​=Mparams​+Mgrad​+Mopt​+Mactiv​​

Mparams​, Mgrad​, and Mopt​ scale with the number of parameters. Activation memory Mactiv​ also depends on sequence length and batch size.

显存 ≈ 存储的数值个数 × 每个数值的字节数. 推理时主要存参数和激活值 (中间结果); 训练还要存梯度和优化器状态. 训练显存 = 参数 + 梯度 + 优化器状态 + 激活值. 前三项只和参数量有关; 激活值还和序列长度、批大小有关 (反向传播要用到前向的中间结果, 所以必须存着).

浮点精度
Floating-point precision · FP32/FP16

Slide 10–11

Floating-point numbers use bits for the sign, the exponent, the significand.

Two common 16-bit formats are:

signexponentsignificand
FP161510
BF16187

BF16 uses more bits for the exponent and fewer for the significand:

  • larger dynamic range,
  • lower numerical precision.

Both require 2 bytes/value. For comparison, FP32 requires 4 bytes/value.

FP32/FP16 ( (Maxime Labonne) )

You can represent every float like this: (−1)S⋅2e−bias⋅1.m (bias = 15 for FP16, 127 for BF16/FP32)

Modern accelerators also support FP8 and even FP4 for selected training operations; mixed precision remains an active area of research.

浮点数由符号位、指数位、尾数位 (significand) 组成. FP16: 5 位指数、10 位尾数; BF16 (brain float): 8 位指数、7 位尾数. BF16 指数位和 FP32 一样多, 所以数值范围和 FP32 相同 (最大约 3.4⋅1038, FP16 只到 65 504), 但精度低 (约 2–3 位有效数字). 训练时溢出比精度不够更致命, 所以大模型训练普遍用 BF16. 两种都占 2 字节, FP32 占 4 字节.

读图: 一个浮点数的值是 (−1)S⋅2e−bias⋅1.m. FP32 的 π: 符号 0; 指数 10000000 = 128, 减去偏置 127 得 1; 尾数 1.5707964; 值 2×1.5707964=3.1415927. FP16 的 π: 指数 10000 = 16, 减去偏置 15 得 1; 尾数 1001001000 表示 1+2−1+2−4+2−7=1.5703125; 值 3.140625, 显示为 3.141. 只有 10 位尾数, 精度明显差.

幻灯片错误: 图里 FP16 那一行的公式写成 (−1)0×2128−127×1.571. FP16 只有 5 位指数, 指数位 10000 是 16, 偏置是 15 (正文下面自己也写了「bias = 15 for FP16」), 应为 216−15; 128 − 127 是从上面 FP32 那一行照抄的. 结果 3.141 碰巧不受影响, 因为两者的差都是 1. 标题「( (Maxime Labonne) )」多了一层括号.

每个参数的训练显存
Training memory per parameter

Slide 12

Assume BF16 parameters and gradients, and AdamW. For each parameter, training stores:

QuantityMemory
BF16 parameter2 bytes
BF16 gradient2 bytes
FP32 Adam momentum4 bytes
FP32 Adam variance4 bytes

For a model with P parameters: Mparams+grad+opt​≈12P bytes​

Example: for a 7B-parameter model, 12⋅7⋅109=84 GB.

This does not yet include activation memory.

假设参数和梯度用 BF16, 优化器 AdamW: 每个参数要存参数 2 字节、梯度 2 字节、Adam 的一阶矩 (动量) 和二阶矩 (方差) 各 4 字节 (FP32), 共 12 字节. 70 亿参数就是 84 GB, 还没算激活值. 一块 80 GB 的 A100/H100 装不下, 这就是 10.3 节要讲分布式训练的原因.

常见的混合精度训练 (Micikevicius et al. 2018) 还会额外保存一份 FP32 的主权重 (master weights, 4 字节): BF16 的权重只用来做前向和反向, 参数更新在 FP32 副本上做, 否则很小的更新量会被 BF16 的低精度直接舍掉. 这样每个参数是 2 + 2 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 16 字节, 7B 模型约 112 GB; ZeRO 论文 (Rajbhandari et al. 2020) 用的就是这个 16 字节的数. 课件的 12 字节对应「不存 FP32 主权重」的做法.

模型放得进一块 GPU 吗
Will my model fit on a GPU?

Slide 13

Consider a 7B-parameter model.

BF16 parameters: 2⋅7⋅109=14 GB

Training state: 12⋅7⋅109=84 GB

Activations add further memory and depend strongly on batch size, sequence length, and architecture. Lv et al., ACL 2024 report about 31% activation memory for one LLaMA-7B setup.

Activation memory can often be traded for extra re-computation (activation checkpointing): less memory ⟺ more compute

7B 模型: 只做推理时 BF16 参数 14 GB, 一块 24 GB 的消费级显卡放得下; 训练状态要 84 GB. 激活值还要额外的显存, 和批大小、序列长度、结构关系很大; Lv 等 (ACL 2024) 报告在某个 LLaMA-7B 设置下激活值约占 31%. 激活值可以用「重计算」换显存 (激活检查点): 前向时只保存少数几层的输出, 反向需要时再从最近的检查点重新算一遍, 显存少了, 计算多了 (约多一次前向).

10.2 训练 LLM: 规模定律
Training LLMs: Scaling laws

学习目标: 从算力预算到模型设计
Learning goals · From compute budget to model design

Slide 0–1

Deep Learning for NLP — Training LLMs — Scaling laws

Learning goals: Understand scaling laws

From compute budget to model design

Training compute is approximately C≈6PD, where P is the number of parameters and D the number of training tokens. For a fixed compute budget C, PD≈ constant.

We can therefore spend our compute on

  • a larger model trained on fewer tokens, or
  • a smaller model trained on more tokens.

Which choice gives the best model? Scaling laws help us answer this question.

目标: 理解规模定律 (scaling laws). 接着 10.1 节: 训练算力 C≈6PD; 预算固定时 PD 固定, 是把算力花在「大模型、少数据」还是「小模型、多数据」上? 规模定律回答这个问题. 这份课件是 9.6 节 (旧版 9scale) 的重写版.

什么是规模定律, 为什么重要
What are scaling laws? · Why were scaling laws important?

Slide 2–3

Kaplan et al., 2020

Language-model loss changes predictably with scale. Key scaling variables are

  • model size P,
  • training data D,
  • training compute C.

Over large ranges, loss approximately follows power laws, e.g., L(D)∝D−α.

Increasing only one factor eventually gives diminishing returns.

The results of Kaplan et al. were influential because they suggested that progress from scaling was remarkably predictable.

  • Larger models and more data reliably reduced loss.
  • Trends observed at small scale could be extrapolated to much larger training runs.
  • Model scale mattered more than many details of model shape, such as depth vs. width.
  • Larger models were more sample-efficient: they achieved a given loss with fewer training examples.

Scaling became a quantitative tool for planning LLM training.

Kaplan 等 (2020, OpenAI) 发现: 语言模型的损失随规模变化可以预测. 关键变量是模型大小 P、训练数据 D、训练算力 C; 在很大范围内, 损失近似服从幂律 (power law), 如 L(D)∝D−α. 只增加其中一个因素, 收益最终递减. 这些结果影响很大, 因为它们说明规模带来的进步是可预测的: 更大的模型、更多的数据稳定地降低损失; 小规模实验观察到的趋势可以外推到大得多的训练; 规模比深度与宽度之类的形状细节更重要; 大模型样本效率更高, 用更少的样本达到同样的损失. 规模定律于是成了规划 LLM 训练的定量工具.

幂律的意思: 两边取对数, logL=−αlogD+c, 在对数-对数坐标里是一条直线. 数据量每增加 10 倍, 损失乘以同一个系数 10−α, 所以越往后同样倍数的数据带来的绝对下降越小, 这就是「收益递减」.

幂律长什么样; 只扩一样不够
What does a power law look like? · Scaling one thing is not enough

Slide 4–5

Validation loss decreases smoothly as training compute increases. The approximately straight trend on log–log axes indicates a power law. Brown et al., 2020

(Slide 5 zeigt dieselbe Abbildung.)

For a fixed model size, more training initially reduces loss strongly, but improvements become smaller. Likewise, increasing model size without enough training data eventually gives diminishing returns.

Good scaling requires balancing model size and training data.

读图: 每条曲线是一个模型大小 (颜色从紫 105 到黄 1011 个参数) 随训练进行的验证损失, 横轴是训练用的算力. 所有曲线的下边缘 (包络, 虚线) 在对数坐标里是一条直线 L=2.57⋅C−0.048: 给定算力, 能达到的最低损失服从幂律. 单看一条曲线: 开始下降很快, 然后变平 (同一个模型训练再久收益也越来越小); 这时换一个更大的模型 (下一条曲线) 才能继续沿着包络往下走. 所以模型大小和训练数据要平衡增长.

损失的规模定律
A scaling law for loss

Slide 6

Loss can be modeled as a function of both model size and training data:

L(P,D)=1.61+P0.34406.4​+D0.28410.7​​

where

  • P is the number of parameters,
  • D is the number of training tokens,
  • L(P,D) is cross-entropy loss on new text.

Increasing either P or D reduces its contribution to the loss, but with diminishing returns. Hoffmann et al., 2022

Hoffmann 等 (2022, Chinchilla 论文) 把损失写成参数量和数据量的函数: 一个常数 (无法消除的下限, 即自然语言本身的熵) 加上两项, 分别随 P 和 D 按幂律减小. 增大 P 或 D 都只减小自己那一项, 而且收益递减; 只增大一个, 另一项会成为瓶颈.

例: Chinchilla (P = 700 亿, D=1.4 万亿) 代入论文的系数得 1.94; Gopher (2800 亿参数, 3000 亿词元) 得 1.99: 参数少 4 倍, 预测损失反而更低.

幻灯片错误: 常数项印成 1.61, 论文式 (10) 拟合的是 E=1.69 (其余 406.4、410.7、0.34、0.28 都对), 即 L(P,D)=1.69+406.4/P0.34+410.7/D0.28. 上面的两个预测值是按 1.69 算的. 9.6 节的旧版课件有同样的错误.

练习: 固定预算怎么分配
How should we spend a fixed compute budget?

Slide 7

Recall: C≈6PD. Suppose two training runs have the same compute budget:

PD
A109109
B1081010

Both have the same product PD. For this exercise, use the simplified scaling law

L(P,D)=2+P1/31000​+D1/41000​.

Which configuration should achieve lower loss?

两个训练方案算力相同 (PD=1018): A 是 10 亿参数、10 亿词元; B 是 1 亿参数、100 亿词元. 用简化的规模定律算哪个损失更低.

A: 1000/103=1, 1000/109/4=1000/177.8=5.62, L=2+1+5.62=8.62. B: 1000/108/3=1000/464.2=2.15, 1000/1010/4=1000/316.2=3.16, L=2+2.15+3.16=7.32. B 更好 (Python 验算: 8.623 和 7.317). 原因: A 的数据项 5.62 远大于参数项 1, 数据是瓶颈; 把预算从参数挪到数据上, 数据项降得比参数项涨得多. 最优分配点是两项的边际收益相等的地方, 这正是下一张的「算力最优」.

算力最优训练与 Chinchilla
Compute-optimal training · Chinchilla: smaller model, more data · Were previous LLMs too large?

Slide 8–10

Given a fixed compute budget C, choose model size P and training data D to minimize loss:

minimize L(P,D)subject to6PD=C

Hoffmann et al., 2022

Hoffmann et al. estimated the optimal trade-off empirically using hundreds of training runs with different model sizes and dataset sizes. Their conclusion:

For a fixed compute budget, models should generally be smaller and trained on more data than previously assumed.

Chinchilla: smaller model, more data — Chinchilla was designed to test the compute-optimal prediction.

  • Chinchilla: 70B parameters, 1.4T training tokens
  • About 4× fewer parameters than Gopher
  • About 4× more training tokens

Despite being much smaller, Chinchilla

  • outperformed Gopher,
  • required less memory for inference,
  • had lower inference cost.

Bigger is not always better: training longer can be a better use of compute.

The Chinchilla scaling law predicted that, for a given compute budget, many earlier LLMs used Hoffmann et al., 2022

  • too many parameters,
  • too few training tokens.

Scaling laws shifted compute from model size to data.

算力最优训练: 在 6PD=C 的约束下最小化 L(P, D). Hoffmann 等用几百次不同模型大小、数据量的训练实验经验地估计最优比例, 结论: 预算固定时, 模型应该比之前以为的更小、训练数据更多. 他们训练 Chinchilla 来检验: 700 亿参数、1.4 万亿词元; 和 Gopher (2800 亿参数、3000 亿词元) 用的算力相同, 参数少 4 倍, 数据多约 4.7 倍. 结果 Chinchilla 尽管小得多, 却全面超过 Gopher, 推理时还更省显存、更便宜. 「越大越好」不总成立, 训练更久可能更划算.

读图: 横轴算力, 纵轴参数量. 三条彩色实线是 Hoffmann 三种方法估计的「给定算力的最优参数量」, 黑色虚线是 Kaplan 2020 的估计, 更陡 (Kaplan 主张算力增加时主要加参数). 星号是实际模型: Gopher (280B)、GPT-3 (175B)、Megatron-Turing NLG (530B) 都在实线上方, 即对它们的算力来说参数太多、数据太少; Chinchilla 正好在线上. 规模定律因此把算力从模型大小转向了数据. 常用的经验法则: 算力最优时约每个参数 20 个训练词元 (Chinchilla: 1.4 万亿 / 700 亿 = 20).

要点小结
Main takeaway

Slide 11

Scaling laws make LLM training a resource-allocation problem. For a fixed compute budget, C≈6PD, so more parameters mean fewer training tokens, and vice versa. Empirical scaling laws tell us how to balance both:

choose P and D jointly, not independently

Chinchilla showed that many earlier LLMs were too large and undertrained for their compute budget. A smaller, better-trained model can also reduce inference memory and cost.

规模定律把训练 LLM 变成一个资源分配问题: 预算固定, 参数多了数据就少, 反之亦然; 要同时选 P 和 D. Chinchilla 表明之前许多 LLM 对它们的预算来说太大、训练不足; 更小但训练更充分的模型推理也更省.

今天的实际做法往往超出算力最优: Llama 3 8B 训练了约 15 万亿词元, 每个参数近 2000 个词元. 原因是 Chinchilla 只优化训练算力, 而一个模型要被调用无数次, 推理成本也要算进去: 多花训练算力把小模型练到更好, 总成本更低 (9.6 节旧版课件的 train/test tradeoff 讲的就是这一点).

涌现能力, 还是度量造成的假象
Do new abilities emerge with scale? · Is emergence an artifact of the metric?

Slide 12–13

Some downstream abilities appear only above a certain model scale.

  • Small models perform near chance on a task.
  • Larger models suddenly achieve substantial performance.
  • This has been called an emergent ability.

Wei et al., 2022: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models

Schaeffer et al., 2023 argue that apparent emergence can arise from how performance is measured: A sudden benchmark jump does not imply a sudden change in the underlying model.

  • Underlying model predictions may improve smoothly with scale.
  • Discontinuous metrics such as exact match can turn smooth improvement into an abrupt jump.

有些下游能力似乎只在模型超过某个规模后才出现: 小模型在任务上接近随机, 大模型突然表现很好, 这被称为涌现能力 (Wei et al. 2022). 读图: 四个任务 (多位数运算、国际音标转写、还原打乱的单词、波斯语问答) 上, LaMDA、GPT-3、Gopher、Chinchilla、PaLM 的表现在 1022 FLOPs 左右之前都贴着随机线 (虚线), 之后陡然上升.

Schaeffer 等 (2023) 反驳: 「涌现」可能是度量方式造成的, 基准分数的突然跳跃不等于模型内部的突然变化. 读图: A: 每个词元的交叉熵随参数量平滑下降; B: 于是单个词元正确的概率 exp(−CE) 也平滑上升. 如果用非线性的度量 (C, 精确匹配: 一个 L 个词元的答案全部正确的概率是 pL) 或不连续的度量 (D, 多选题对/错), 同样平滑的进步看起来就像突然出现; 换成线性的度量 (E, 编辑距离) 或连续的度量 (F, Brier 分数), 曲线又是平滑的.

例子: 设答案有 5 个词元, 单个词元正确率从 0.5 平滑涨到 0.9, 精确匹配率 p5 从 0.03 涨到 0.59: 前半段几乎贴着 0, 后半段突然上去.

预训练数据: 混合、筛选和重复
Pretraining data are mixtures · Which data should we keep? · What if we run out of new data?

Slide 14–16

The number of tokens D does not describe the kind of data. Example: Dolma combines several sources

SourceDoc TypeUTF-8 bytes (GB)Documents (millions)Unicode words (billions)Llama tokens (billions)
Common Crawlweb pages9,8123,7341,9282,479
GitHubcode1,043210260411
Redditsocial media3393777289
Semantic Scholarpapers26838.85070
Project Gutenbergbooks20.40.0564.06.0
Wikipedia, Wikibooksencyclopedic16.26.23.74.3
Total11,5194,3672,3183,059

Soldaini et al., 2024: Dolma

The composition of D is itself a design choice.

Example: FineWeb

  • FineWeb contains about 15T filtered web tokens.
  • FineWeb-Edu keeps about 1.3T tokens with high predicted educational value (“useful for teaching”, judged by an LLM-derived classifier).
  • Models trained on FineWeb-Edu perform better on several knowledge and reasoning benchmarks.

If high-quality unique data are limited, one option is to repeat existing data. Muennighoff et al. find that

  • a few repetitions almost as useful as fresh unique data,
  • but additional repetitions increasingly less useful.

词元数 D 说不出数据是什么样的. 例: Dolma (AI2 的开放预训练语料) 由多种来源组成: 网页 (Common Crawl) 占约 81% 的词元, 代码 (GitHub) 13%, 其余是 Reddit、论文、书籍、维基百科; 总计约 3 万亿 Llama 词元. 数据的构成本身就是一个设计选择.

FineWeb (Hugging Face): 约 15 万亿个过滤后的网页词元; FineWeb-Edu 用一个分类器 (用 LLM 打分的结果训练出来的) 只保留「教育价值高、适合教学」的约 1.3 万亿词元. 读图: 同一个模型在不同语料上训练, FineWeb-Edu (红) 在整个训练过程中的平均准确率都最高, 只用 1/10 的数据反而更好: 数据质量能部分代替数量.

如果高质量的独特数据不够了, 可以重复使用. Muennighoff 等发现: 重复几次几乎和新数据一样有用, 再多重复则越来越没用. 读图: 实线是他们的「数据受限规模定律」预测的损失, 虚线是假设重复数据和新数据同样有用. 重复约 4 轮以内两线几乎重合; 之后收益迅速递减; 到约 40 轮, 再重复就毫无价值.

原文笔误: 「a few repetitions almost as useful as fresh unique data」少了动词, 应为 a few repetitions are almost as useful.

OLMo 2: 让规模化真正奏效的细节
OLMo 2: details make scaling work · short mid-training, large gains

Slide 17–18

Scaling laws say how to allocate compute. The open-source OLMo 2 LLM shows what is needed so the training run actually remains stable. OLMo Team, 2025: 2 OLMo 2 Furious

ChoiceOLMo 2 takeaway
Repeated textFilter/mask long repeated n-grams; reduces gradient spikes.
InitializationUse N(0,0.02) for all parameters; fewer spikes and better activation/gradient scaling.
Norm placementRMSNorm on attention/MLP outputs, not inputs.
Attention logitsQK-norm prevents very large attention logits.
Logit scaleAdd z-loss to keep output logits from growing too large.
Optimizer detailsLower AdamW ϵ; do not apply weight decay to embeddings.

After long general pretraining, OLMo 2 performs a much shorter targeted mid-training stage on filtered higher-quality data.

ModelTraining tokensAvg.
7B4T + 150B*53.0 → 62.9
13B5T + 600B*58.9 → 68.3
32B6T + 600B*66.3 → 73.3

* Total mid-training compute across several continuations: 7B: 3 × 50B; 13B/32B: 3 × 100B + 300B. All runs start from the same pretrained checkpoint and their final checkpoints are averaged (model soup).

  • Mid-training switches to the curated Dolmino-Mix-1124 mixture and anneals the learning rate.
  • Despite requiring far fewer tokens than general pretraining, it yields large improvements.

规模定律说的是怎么分配算力; 开源的 OLMo 2 (AI2) 展示了要让一次大规模训练稳定跑完需要哪些细节: 过滤或掩掉很长的重复 n-gram (它们会引起梯度尖峰); 所有参数用 N(0,0.02) 初始化 (尖峰更少, 激活和梯度的尺度更好); 把 RMSNorm 放在注意力和 MLP 的输出上而不是输入上; 用 QK-norm (对 Q、K 先归一化) 防止注意力 logits 过大; 加 z-loss (惩罚 softmax 归一化常数的对数) 防止输出 logits 不断变大; 把 AdamW 的 ε 调小, 不对嵌入做 weight decay.

长时间的通用预训练之后, OLMo 2 再做一个短得多的、有针对性的中期训练 (mid-training): 换成精选的 Dolmino-Mix-1124 数据, 学习率退火到 0. 词元只是预训练的几十分之一, 平均分却提高了 7–10 分 (7B 从 53.0 到 62.9). 表中 7B 的 150B 是从同一个检查点出发、用不同数据顺序做 3 次各 50B 的中期训练, 13B/32B 是 3 × 100B 加一次 300B; 最后把这几个检查点的权重平均 (model soup).

规模化的经济和环境代价
Scaling has a financial cost · Environmental costs of training

Slide 19–20

Estimates for training frontier models, based on cloud-compute rental prices (not total development costs):

  • Estimated training compute cost: GPT-3: $4M, GPT-4: $79M, Llama 3.1-405B: $170M.
  • Experiments, tuning, and failed runs add further cost.
  • Estimated training emissions: GPT-3: 588 t, GPT-4: 5,184 t, Llama 3.1-405B: 8,930 t CO2e.
  • Emissions depend on hardware efficiency, datacenter efficiency, and the carbon intensity of electricity.
  • Patterson et al. observed about 5–10× differences across locations. Patterson et al., 2021

按云算力租用价格估计的训练成本 (不是全部研发成本): GPT-3 约 400 万美元, GPT-4 约 7900 万, Llama 3.1-405B 约 1.7 亿; 实验、调参和失败的训练还要另算. 读图: 成本在几年内涨了几个数量级, 最高的是 Gemini 1.0 Ultra (1.92 亿美元).

估计的训练碳排放: GPT-3 588 吨, GPT-4 5184 吨, Llama 3.1-405B 8930 吨 CO2 当量. 排放取决于硬件效率、数据中心效率和电力的碳强度; Patterson 等观察到不同地点之间相差 5–10 倍. 读图: 左上角的对照: 一个美国人一年约 18 吨, 一辆汽车整个寿命 (含燃料) 约 63 吨; Llama 3.1-405B 的训练排放相当于约 140 辆汽车的终生排放.

10.3 训练 LLM: 如何减少计算和显存
Training LLMs: How to reduce compute and memory

学习目标: 为什么要分布式训练
Learning goals · Why distribute LLM training?

Slide 0–1

Deep Learning for NLP — Training LLMs — How to reduce compute and memory

Learning goals

  • Learn about distributed training with data/tensor parallelism
  • Learn about FlashAttention

Why distribute LLM training? Training large models on one GPU has two problems:

  • Speed: training may take too long.
  • Memory: the model and training state may not fit.

Using several GPUs can address both, but the computation must be distributed appropriately. Two basic strategies are:

  • Data parallelism: replicate the model and split the data.
  • Tensor parallelism: split the model itself across GPUs.

Different strategies solve different bottlenecks.

目标: 了解用数据并行和张量并行做分布式训练; 了解 FlashAttention. 只用一块 GPU 训练大模型有两个问题: 速度 (太慢) 和显存 (模型和训练状态放不下, 见 10.1 节的 84 GB). 多块 GPU 能同时解决两者, 但要合适地分配计算. 两种基本策略: 数据并行 (复制模型, 切分数据) 和张量并行 (把模型本身切到多块 GPU 上). 不同策略解决不同的瓶颈. 这份课件是 9.8 节 (旧版 9fast) 的重写版, 新增了 MoE.

数据并行
Data parallelism: same model, different data · What does data parallelism buy us?

Slide 2–3

Each GPU

  • stores a full copy of the model,
  • processes a different part of the batch,
  • computes gradients locally.

The gradients are then averaged across GPUs (All Reduce). All GPUs apply the same update, so their model copies remain identical.

Different GPUs process different training examples in parallel. Therefore, data parallelism can increase training throughput: more GPUs ⟹ more examples processed per second.

But every GPU still stores the entire model.

  • Good for reducing training time.
  • Does not allow a model that is too large for one GPU to fit.
  • Gradient synchronization adds communication overhead.

To split the model itself, we need tensor parallelism.

每块 GPU 存一份完整的模型, 处理批次的不同部分, 在本地算梯度; 然后所有 GPU 之间做 AllReduce 把梯度求平均, 每块 GPU 用同一个平均梯度做同样的更新, 模型副本保持一致. 读图: 全局批次 (Global Batch) 分成 4 个微批次, 分给 GPU 0–3, 每块 GPU 上都有 Layer 0–2; 颜色表示空闲、前向、反向和梯度 AllReduce.

不同 GPU 并行处理不同样本, 所以吞吐量提高: GPU 越多, 每秒处理的样本越多. 但每块 GPU 仍然存着整个模型: 适合缩短训练时间, 不能让单卡放不下的模型放下; 梯度同步还有通信开销. 要切分模型本身, 需要张量并行.

为什么结果和单卡一样: 损失是对批次求平均的, 梯度对样本是线性的, 所以「各卡算自己那份的平均梯度, 再在卡之间平均」等于「整个大批次的平均梯度」(各份大小相同时). 数据并行在数学上等价于用大批次训练.

张量并行; 两者对比
Tensor parallelism: split the model across GPUs · Data vs. tensor parallelism

Slide 4–5

Instead of replicating the full model, split large tensors across GPUs. For a matrix multiplication Y=XW, the weight matrix W can be partitioned across devices. Each GPU

  • stores only part of W,
  • computes part of Y,
  • exchanges intermediate results when needed.
Data parallelismTensor parallelism
Modelreplicatedsplit across GPUs
Datasplitshared/processed jointly
Main benefithigher throughputlarger models fit
Communicationbetween updateswithin layers
  • Data parallelism is useful when the model fits on one GPU, but training is too slow.
  • Tensor parallelism is useful when individual model operations are too large for one GPU.

Large-scale training commonly combines both strategies.

张量并行不复制模型, 而是把大张量切开分到多块 GPU 上. 对矩阵乘法 Y=XW, 可以把 W 切分到各设备: 每块 GPU 只存一部分 W, 算出一部分 Y, 需要时交换中间结果. 读图: X 乘权重 A 得到 Y; 把 A 按列切成 A1、A2、A3, 三块 GPU 各算 XAi​=Yi​, 拼起来就是 Y; 每块 GPU 只存 1/3 的权重.

对比: 数据并行复制模型、切分数据, 好处是吞吐量高, 通信发生在两次更新之间 (每步一次梯度同步); 张量并行切分模型、各 GPU 共同处理同一批数据, 好处是大模型放得下, 通信发生在层内 (每一层都要交换中间结果, 频繁, 所以通常只在一台机器内高速互联的 GPU 之间用). 模型单卡放得下、只是太慢, 用数据并行; 单个运算对一块 GPU 来说太大, 用张量并行. 大规模训练通常两者结合 (再加流水线并行, 即按层切分).

注意力为什么费显存; GPU 的存储层次
Why is attention expensive in memory? · The GPU memory hierarchy · Why standard attention moves so much data

Slide 6–8

For a sequence of n tokens, attention computes S=QK⊤, P=softmax(S), O=PV. Both intermediate matrices contain one value for every pair of tokens: S,P∈Rn×n. Hence, storing them requires O(n2) memory. Doubling the sequence length makes these matrices about 4 times larger.

Can we compute exact attention without storing these large intermediate matrices?

GPU memory has a hierarchy:

  • Static Random-Access Memory (SRAM): very fast, but small
  • High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM): much larger, but slower

GPU compute reads from and writes to SRAM. Moving data and results between HBM and SRAM can become the bottleneck. Reducing this memory traffic can make computation faster.

A standard GPU implementation typically performs: Q,K⟶S=QK⊤⟶P=softmax(S)⟶O=PV. Between these operations,

  1. Q,K are read from HBM; S is computed and written to HBM,
  2. S is read back; P is computed and written to HBM,
  3. P,V are read back to compute O.

Thus, the large n×n matrices S and P are repeatedly transferred between HBM and SRAM.

FlashAttention avoids materializing S and P in HBM. Dao et al., 2022

n 个词元的注意力: S=QK⊤ (分数), P=softmax(S) (权重), O=PV. S 和 P 都是 n×n, 每对词元一个数, 存储 O(n2); 序列长度翻倍, 它们变成 4 倍大. 能不能不存这两个大矩阵而算出精确的注意力?

读图: GPU 的存储是金字塔: 片上 SRAM 极快 (19TB/s) 但很小 (A100 上共约 20 MB); HBM (显存) 大 (40 GB) 但慢一个数量级 (1.5TB/s); CPU 内存更大更慢. 计算单元只能读写 SRAM, 数据要在 HBM 和 SRAM 之间来回搬, 搬运常常成为瓶颈. 标准实现分三步, 每一步都把 n×n 的 S 或 P 写回 HBM、下一步再读进来, 来回搬了好几趟. FlashAttention 的思路就是根本不在 HBM 里生成 S 和 P.

FlashAttention: 分块计算
FlashAttention: compute attention block by block · An illustration

Slide 9–10

Take one query block Qi​ and process all key/value blocks in turn: (K1​,V1​),(K2​,V2​),… For each block j:

  1. load Qi​,Kj​,Vj​ from HBM into SRAM,
  2. compute Sij​=Qi​Kj⊤​,
  3. update the running softmax normalization,
  4. update the partial output Oi​, discard Sij​ and its softmax values.

After the final block, Oi​ is normalized and written to HBM. All blocks are processed, but not stored at the same time.

During the forward pass, each score block Sij​ and its softmax probabilities are used and then discarded. During backpropagation, the same blocks are recomputed from Qi​ and Kj​ when they are needed again.

more arithmetic ⟺ less memory and HBM traffic

取一个查询块 Qi​, 依次处理所有键值块: 对每个块 j, 把 Qi​,Kj​,Vj​ 从 HBM 读进 SRAM; 算 Sij​=Qi​Kj⊤​; 更新正在累积的 softmax 归一化量; 更新部分输出 Oi​, 然后丢掉 Sij​ 和它的 softmax. 最后一块处理完, 把 Oi​ 归一化并写回 HBM. 所有块都算过, 但从来没有同时存下.

难点是 softmax: 它要对整行归一化, 而分块时一次只看到一行的一部分. 「在线 softmax」的做法: 维护当前的行最大值 m 和分母 ℓ = Σexp(s−m); 新块来了, 如果出现更大的最大值 m′, 就把已有的分母和部分输出都乘以 em−m′ 修正, 再加上新块的贡献. 最后得到的结果和一次性算完全相同, 所以是精确注意力, 不是近似.

读图 (Slide 10): 左边三个操作依次进行, 每做一个就在显存 (Memory) 和计算单元 (Compute) 之间来回搬一次; 右边把它们融合成一个核, 数据只搬进一次、搬出一次, 中间结果都留在计算单元里. 前向时用完就丢; 反向传播需要这些块时, 从 Qi​、Kj​ 重新算一遍. 多做了计算, 换来更少的显存和 HBM 读写, 而对 GPU 来说读写才是瓶颈, 所以整体反而更快.

混合专家 (MoE): Mixtral
Mixture-of-Experts · How does Mixtral select experts? · Sparse routing saves compute

Slide 11–13

FlashAttention makes attention more efficient. MoE (e.g. Mixtral Jiang et al., 2024: Mixtral) changes the feed-forward part of the Transformer.

H→ Self-Attention →H~→ Feed-Forward Network (FFN) →H′.

  • Self-attention remains dense.
  • The single FFN is replaced by 8 experts. (Increase capacity.)
  • For each token, only 2 experts are evaluated. (But use efficiently.)

For each token representation h~∈R4096 after self-attention, a small router computes 8 scores: r=Wrouter​h~, Wrouter​∈R8×4096.

  • Select the top 2 experts.
  • Both process the same token representation h~.
  • Their outputs are weighted and combined. y=wi​Ei​(h~)+wj​Ej​(h~).

Each expert in Mixtral is a full SwiGLU FFN: 4096→14336→4096. It has three projection matrices (including a gating projection): Shazeer, 2020

Pexpert​≈3⋅4096⋅14336≈176M.

Mixtral stores 8 experts, but evaluates only 2 per token: 8×176M stored vs. 2×176M evaluated.

(The router adds only about 8⋅4096≈33,000 parameters.) Across the model: 47B total parameters ≈ 13B active/token

More capacity without activating all parameters for every token.

FlashAttention 让注意力更高效; 混合专家 (Mixture-of-Experts, MoE) 改的是前馈部分. 以 Mixtral 8x7B 为例: 自注意力仍是稠密的; 原来的一个 FFN 换成 8 个「专家」(各自独立的 FFN), 容量变大; 但每个词元只用其中 2 个, 计算量不变多. 读图 (Slide 11): 一个块 = RMSNorm → 因果自注意力 (多头, 带 RoPE) → 残差 → RMSNorm → SwiGLU 前馈网络 → 残差, 重复 N 层; MoE 只替换其中的前馈网络.

路由: 自注意力之后每个词元的表示 h~ (4096 维) 经过一个小的路由矩阵 (8 × 4096) 得到 8 个分数; 选分数最高的 2 个专家, 两个都处理同一个 h~; 输出按权重 (对两个分数做 softmax) 加权相加. 读图 (Slide 12): 路由器把输入送给选中的专家, 同时给出门控权重 (gating weights), 专家输出按权重加起来.

参数账: 每个专家是一个 SwiGLU FFN (4096 → 14336 → 4096), 有三个投影矩阵 (门控、上投影、下投影), 约 3⋅4096⋅14336=1.76 亿; 每层存 8 个、用 2 个; 路由器只有 8⋅4096=32768 个参数. 整个模型 (32 层) 共 467 亿参数, 每个词元只激活约 129 亿 (我用 32 层、分组查询注意力、32 000 词表逐项算过, 和 47B / 13B 一致). 结果: 推理计算量像 13B 的模型, 能力接近大得多的稠密模型; 但显存要装下全部 47B.

易错: 「8 × 176M」是每一层的专家参数, 不是整个模型的. 名字「8x7B」也不是 56B: 注意力层和嵌入层是共享的, 只有前馈部分有 8 份.
